title: Lunar Modulator parameter metadata
description: What a build can make, exported from C (fm1-render --meta on the desktop, a wasm call in the simulator; stage E2), so an editor generates its controls and never hard-codes a name, range or uid: every engine, audio effect, MIDI effect and modulation kind with its parameters (names, abbreviations, units, ranges, defaults, LOG law, ENUM entries, pages and knobs, flags, uids, aliases), the modulation sources, units and ports, the FM6 voice fields, the project keys, the ids a build knows but lacks, and the file caps. Versioned by `lunar`: a minor level adds members, never moves one. Not a loadable file kind: a state loader refuses it. Level 1.1 (stage ED0, notes/2026-10-06-web-editor.md §6) adds what the advanced editor reads besides the parameters: each module's licence and whether it is GPL, its page names and an audio effect's group, each parameter's knob detent (`step`), the effect groups, the refusal codes with their words, the telemetry block's layout and the export's id (`meta_id`). An export at 1.1 or above has all of them; a 1.0 export has none of the top-level ones, and still validates.

rate.description: The rate files are checked at (the FM-1's), Hz.

ram_budget.description: Bytes the engines, effects and modulation may take (FM1_APP_RAM_BUDGET).

gpl.description: Whether FM1_GPL_MODS was on: GPL modules are in this build.

modules.description: The module list the build was made with (FM1_MODULES, engines/modules/catalogue.mk): `all`, a list file's name such as `default`, or `custom`. The modules it leaves out are in known_ids with the reason `list`.

engines.description: Sound engines, audio effects and MIDI effects, in registry order.

units.description: The units a cable can reach, by the name files use.

host.description: The host unit's parameters (pitch per sound and amp).

dx7.description: FM6's user voices: the VCED fields a file's `ops` and `globals` hold, in order.

known_ids.description: Ids this build knows but does not have, with the reason a refusal gives: `list` for the modules its module list leaves out (FM1_MODULES, engines/modules/catalogue.mk), else engines/known-ids.json's.

since.description: For a retired id: the version that retired it.

limits.description: The reader's caps (notes/2026-10-06-state-files.md §16), so an editor refuses what a load would.

bytes.description: File bytes after inflating, by kind.

effect_groups.description: 1.1: the groups an editor lists the audio effects under, in order (the project page's: Reverbs; Chorus, space and delay; Filters and EQ; Grit and colour; Dynamics; then the test effects). A hint, never a rule.

refusals.description: 1.1: why something was refused (include/fm1_refusal.h), every code with the words a person reads, and a known id's reason in words. Codes 1-9 are the loader's (FM1_STATE_*), 10 a unit's arena, 32 and on a cable's (the planner's per-slot reasons, fm1_mod_slot_refusal). A memory figure is a percentage of the FM-1's budget, never bytes. A code never changes its number or its name.

of.description: What gives it: a load, choosing a unit's engine or effect (or switching the arp on), the rack, a cable.

detail.description: The line under it, with the {fills} whoever shows it fills in; null when the words say it all.

fills.description: The {fills} the detail names, in order: name, why, level, reads, rate, pct (a whole percentage of the FM-1's budget, rounded up as the screen's meter rounds), what, used, max, kind, line, col, from, to, param.

known.description: A known-but-absent id's reason (known_ids) in words; retired fills {since}.

telemetry.description: 1.1: the live block the editor reads (include/fm1_tele.h; decision ED11): floats, at most `hz` blocks a second, only the subscribed rows filled. Field f of item i of row r of a section is the float at offset + (r * max(1, len(items)) + i) * len(fields) + f; row r is bit mask + r of the subscription mask, `mask_words` words of 32 bits.

version.description: FM1_TELE_VERSION: a new section or row goes at the end and raises it.

unit.description: The fields' unit: a parameter unit's name, `port` (each output's own range) or `param` (the destination's unit).

items.description: Empty when each row holds one unnamed item.

meta_id.description: 1.1: CRC-32 (zlib's) of this export written without its `made` and `meta_id`, as 8 lower-case hex digits: the same for every build with the same registries, rate, budget and GPL switch, whoever wrote the file. The virtual FM-1's module returns it (fm1w_meta_id), so a static meta.json is checked against the module before it is trusted.

flag.description: FM1_PARAM_* by name: latch 0x01, smooth 0x02, nolock 0x04, mod 0x08, input 0x10, poly 0x20, log 0x40 (API v3), keysrc 0x80 (kept for the side-chain stage), focus 0x0100 and per_focus 0x0200 (API v4).

param.description: One parameter, in its table's order. A FLOAT moves between min and max, on the LOG law when its flags say log (position u = log2(v / min) / log2(max / min)); an ENUM's value is an index into entries.

step.description: 1.1: one knob detent: a list's one entry; a linear FLOAT's step in its unit (a hundredth of its range, or whole units on a wide integer range); for a `log` parameter a share of its position u (0.01, a ratio). An editor's arrow keys step by it.

knob.description: The knob on that page, 1-4; absent when hidden.

hidden.description: Not on a knob page: an INPUT, a Schwung module's hidden parameter, the host's.

entries.description: ENUM only: entry names by index; append-only.

aliases.description: Names this parameter had before; a reader takes them.

entry_aliases.description: ENUM only: old entry names and the index each now names.

group.description: 1.1, audio effects: the effect group it is listed under (effect_groups), or null.

licence.description: SPDX expression of the code it is built from (written from 1.1).

gpl.description: 1.1: the licence names a GNU licence: the module is built in only with the GPL switch on (FM1_GPL_MODS), and a shared build leaves it out.

pads.description: A pad kit's notes, or null.

retired.description: Removed parameters' last names and their retired uids; a reader passes such a value on by uid, as #UID.

normal.description: Gate inputs: the system source read while no cable reaches it, or null.

guid.description: 4 characters, saved in the binary container.

licence.description: SPDX expression of the code it is built from (written from 1.1).

data.description: Pattern data saved with it, or null.

sound.description: The sound unit (1-4) a per-sound source follows.

pageNames.description: 1.1: a module's knob pages, one entry each, by name where the panel names the page (the arpeggiator's PLAY ... SEED), else null: the panel shows that page by its number, and so does an editor.
